observations: Ask uses a compact stable header/context, a distinct user bubble and assistant content, bottom composer, and source footer after answer prose. Intro/suggestions disappear after the first user message.

Long mobile answers require transcript scrolling; latest-message view naturally clips earlier prose above the viewport. Scrollback stays in place until the visitor explicitly jumps to latest or sends a new message.
Source pills wrap within320px with no horizontal overflow; header close control and composer send control remain visible.

All deferred campaign photos are loaded before full-page capture; fine texture remains somewhat soft atquality60 but subject detail is recognizable. Public page hierarchy and donation controls remain intact at all3widths.

scopeLimits: Local headless Chrome lab verification; no cross-browser coverage, physical touch-device testing, or authenticated reference-product behavior.
All campaigns and contributions are fictional/simulated; cookie-bound demo persistence does not establish cross-device identity.
Application process restart persistence is a separate parent-run check; this suite verifies reload persistence only.
Native sharing and clipboard outcomes are controlled fixtures; no recipient delivery or external conversion is claimed.
No field responsiveness, retention improvement, or Lighthouse performance-budget claim follows from these tests.
IME coverage uses synthetic composition/key events; physical mobile keyboards, browser viewport changes under an on-screen keyboard, and screen-reader spoken output were not tested.
Preview tests are a local reproduction of forwarded origins; they do not directly observe/control the user embedded browser. InvalidAsk probes pass the origin gate without paid model calls.
Chat screenshot answer prose is a controlled layout fixture, not a live answer. Live chat/provider acceptance is recorded separately by the parent.
